```{r}
library(abcdutils)
library(here)
library(ggplot2)

core_path <- path_maker(here("data/abcd/core"))
import <- function(path) {
    return(abcd_load(core_path(path)))
}

proc_path       <- path_maker(here(paste0("data/abcd/results/processed")))

mtbi_ful_df <- readRDS(proc_path("2025_09_16_mtbi_ful_df.rds"))

mtbi_ful_df$"uid"

ph_y_anthro <- import("physical-health/ph_y_anthro.csv")

anthro_data <- ph_y_anthro |>
    filter_timepoint(0) |>
    dplyr::select(subjectkey, anthroheightcalc, anthroweightcalc) |>
    dplyr::mutate(uid = paste0("uid_", subjectkey)) |>
    dplyr::select(-subjectkey)

    dplyr::inner_join(mtbi_ful_df, by = "uid")

anthro_data |>
    ggplot(aes(x = cluster, y = anthroweightcalc)) +
    geom_boxplot()

search_dd("anthroheightcalc")

search_dd("anthroweightcalc")

```
